text:
olivia: quick sync — ran int4 bring-up for cypress-8b on a mixed traffic slice (search + chat). sharing cost/latency/quality numbers and a proposed hybrid routing + canary plan.

jess: can you paste the numbers? :eyes:

olivia: numbers from yesterday's run vs our current int8 baseline:
- int8 (baseline): p50 18ms, p95 48ms, cost per 1k tokens = $0.72
- int4 (quantized): p50 14ms, p95 68ms, cost per 1k tokens = $0.28
- Quality: longform F1 delta = -1.6 pts, QA exact match delta = -0.9% (small but nonzero)

sam: big cost win but p95 tail regression worries me for chat. any mitigation ideas?

olivia: hypothesis: tail is KV-cache related + attention kernel variance on longer contexts. when we force warmstart (persistent KV cache hit) int4 p95 falls to ~52ms. So we can recover most of the latency regression by routing strategy.

manu: what's the distribution of warm sessions? how many requests would benefit?

olivia: sample traffic: persistent sessions (~>1 prior turn) = 42% of traffic. For those, int4 p95 = 50ms. For stateless requests int4 p95 still ~70ms. So a hybrid routing rule makes sense: prefer int4 for warmed sessions, prefer int8 for fresh stateless single-turn queries.

olivia: proposed routing sketch:
```
route_policy {
  if session_len > 2 and model_variant == "cypress-8b-int4" -> prefer_int4
  else -> prefer_int8
}
```

jess: behavioral / safety evals? any regressions on hallucination or instruction-following?

olivia: run on our prompt-set: small uptick in hallucination on summarization slice (rouge-L delta ~ -2.2%) concentrated in 'aggressive compression' prompts. Other slices (code, QA) show <1% deltas. Recommend conservative canary.

sam: ok product ask: what's the rollout and what do we tell GTN in the recommendation?

olivia: rollout proposal:
1) Canary: 10% traffic for 48h (split: 70% stateless, 30% warmed) with tight monitoring on p95, hallucination signal, and user-visible regressions.
2) Success criteria: hallucination delta < 1% absolute and p95 (observed) < 55ms across blended traffic.
3) If pass -> expand to 50% for 7 days with engagement A/B (CTR/DUA) comparison. If fail -> rollback to int8 and run focused debugging.

olivia: unit econ note: raw per-1k token cost reduction ~61%. For a midsize GTN customer (~30M tokens/mo) this maps to ~$12k/mo savings (rough estimate, depends on session mix).

ops-bot: deploy canary started by infra-cp at 1759501200 :rocket:

manu: I'll produce a priming-heavy eval batch tomorrow to validate the summarization regressions and also surface prompt-engineering fixes.

jess: ack — please add the prompt-set and the canary tag to the compare dashboard and label as `cypress-int4-2026-03`. Also add an eval for hallucination with manual spot-checks.

olivia: will add dashboards + alerts. tagging @sam @jess @manu for follow-ups. tl;dr: int4 looks promising with hybrid routing + a conservative canary; main risks are p95 tail for stateless requests and a small summarization hallucination uptick — mitigations planned. :white_check_mark:
